messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Besides machinery and partly completed machinery, to which 'related products' does Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 apply under Article 2(1)?

response.text: Oltre alle macchine e alle quasi-macchine, a quali "prodotti correlati" si applica il regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 ai sensi dell'articolo 2, paragrafo 1?
